Per kind: font (12/8), px = widest line, lines = lines per page (msg) or 1, last_px = last line of a page (page arrow), status measured|guess. Kinds not listed get a 'no budget' warning from tools/lint.py. Byte caps of arm9 slots come from insert.text_cap (max-2, KIND_CAP).
